description: payeecheck: Does this payTo address actually get paid? Reads inbound USDC transfers on Base from a 100%-coverage snapshot and reports the count and total. Built for the question our own on-chain census says every buyer should ask first: of 879 directory-listed x402 sellers, 805 received nothing in 24 hours. Returns paid true/false plus transfers and USD, with the snapshot window and its caveats. Base mainnet USDC only. Not a trust score.
